text:
ana-marketing: Quick idea 1: run a country-aware pricing microexperiment that tests VAT visibility + CTA copy and ties a webinar gating flow to high-value calculator submissions. Want to surface clearer EU pricing and use the calc to drive qualified webinar signups.

tom-growth: Agree. Main axes: VAT shown inline vs VAT shown in modal footnote; CTA: 'Get started 14-day trial' vs 'Estimate your cost'. Also test package label swap: 'Company' vs 'Scale'.

mira-ux: I'll make 3 mock flows: (1) inline VAT row, inline calc, (2) inline price without VAT then VAT modal on toggle, (3) localized prices (EUR) with VAT included. Figma: https://figma.com/file/eu-pricing-experiment (placeholder).

kai-analytics: Instrumentation plan: events: pricing_view, calc_interaction (props: variant, country, currency_shown), calc_submitted (props: est_mrr_band), webinar_reg. I'll create the funnel in GA + Looker. Suggest gating experiment at country/regional level (EU vs non-EU).

leah-cs: Routing: if calc_submitted est_mrr_band >= 'enterprise' OR user opts into webinar and indicates "I'm evaluating for my company", route to AE queue with tag `lead:pricing_calc_webinar`. Otherwise send to standard nurture. Need webhook fields: est_band, currency, vat_included.

arnaud-legal: Watch for language like "VAT included" vs "VAT may apply" across EU markets. I'll review copy but need final text at least 48h before deploy. Avoid pricing guarantees that could conflict with regional tax rules.

devops-bot: rollout-note: feature flag: pricing_eu_vat_test. Canary: 5% traffic for 72h, health check on pricing_endpoint latency and calc_submitted error rate. Notify #release-war-room on anomalies.

ana-marketing: (typo) sorry, ana: Acceptance criteria suggestions: primary = start_trial_ctr uplift vs baseline; secondary = webinar_reg_rate, faq_open_rate (down 10% desired), inbound_qualified_rate. Run to 8k pricing impressions or 10 days.

tom-growth: Hypothesis: showing VAT upfront for EU reduces FAQ opens and increases trust -> higher webinar signups among EU visitors by ~12%. CTA with explicit trial length should increase start-trial clarity.

mira-ux: Copy stubs: VAT inline label: "Prices shown excl. VAT. VAT calculated at checkout." VAT included label: "Prices include VAT (where applicable)." CTA variants: "Get started 14-day trial" vs "Estimate your monthly cost".

kai-analytics: Metric capture schema (final by Mon): pricing_view, calc_opened, calc_submitted {est_band: low|mid|high|enterprise, currency, vat_flag}, trial_started, webinar_registered. I'll provide daily delta dashboard.

leah-cs: CS playbook: auto-email template for high-value calc submitters offering a webinar seat + AE intro. Add a one-click calendar link.

arnaud-legal: I'll sign off on EU copy by Friday. Note: for certain APAC markets we may need different tax phrasing.

devops-bot: deploy-checklist: feature flag ready, experiment cohort routing in CDN, GA tags verified, webhook payloads to CRM tested in staging.

ana-marketing: I'll assemble the brief and PRD and post to #marketing-review. Next actions: Mira to deliver mocks by Tue, Kai to finalize events, Legal to sign EU phrasing, Eng to estimate flagging effort. :spiral_calendar:
